description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TAG_REFERENCES(object_name, object_domain) - the tags on one object, read the way a real account exposes them. Both arguments are required; a bare object name resolves against the current database and schema; TABLE covers every table-like object (passing VIEW is refused in favour of TABLE); COLUMN takes a four-part name whose last part is the column; SCHEMA, DATABASE and WAREHOUSE are domains of their own. Creation-time [WITH] TAG clauses are recorded, not merely accepted, and a column's own clause stays on the column. Converted 1:1 from features/TagReferencesTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach fixture (tag cost_center, table tagged with a table tag and a column tag on V, view tagged_view with a view tag) is inlined per test.
